entities.summary: Rossana Marisol Prado Villegas, is a Chilean physician, psychiatrist and academic who became the first woman to hold the post of president of the University of Chile Student Federation which was founded in 1906; she was the first and only woman until Camila Vallejo assumed the post in August 2010, followed by Scarlett Mac-Ginty in November 2011.
